map.皮囊式蓄能器容积计算，支持等温（慢速）与绝热（快速）过程: From working pressure range, gas pre-charge pressure and oil volume change, size a bladder accumulator under isothermal or adiabatic assumptions for shock absorption, leakage make-up or auxiliary power.
map.充气压力 P₀ 一般取 0.6~0.9 倍最低工作压力 P₁: Pre-charge P₀ is usually 0.6–0.9 × minimum working pressure P₁
map.等温过程适用于补油保压（动作时间>1min），绝热适用于快速动作（<1min）: Isothermal suits oil make-up/holding (action >1 min); adiabatic suits fast action (<1 min)
map.实际选型应留 10%~20% 余量，并校核疲劳寿命: Reserve 10%–20% margin in practice and check fatigue life
map.压力单位为 MPa，容积单位为 L: Pressure unit is MPa, volume unit is L
map.按保压时间与压力降定气囊容积。: Size the bladder from hold time and pressure drop.
map.吸收脉动与冲击的蓄能器选型。: Select an accumulator to absorb pulsation and shock.
map.校核最低工作压力是否满足执行器。: Check whether minimum working pressure meets the actuator.
map.充气 9 MPa、系统 12→21 MPa、需补油体积已知，按 p1V1^n=p: Pre-charge 9 MPa, system 12→21 MPa, make-up volume known; invert p1V1^n=p2V2^n (n≈1.4) for total volume.
map.最低压力要求提高，则所需总容积增大，过小会保压不足掉压。: Higher minimum pressure needs larger total volume; too small loses pressure during hold.
map.气囊蓄能器靠气体压缩储能，容积随压力按多变过程变化。: A bladder accumulator stores energy by gas compression; volume varies with pressure by a polytropic process.
map.常取系统最低工作压力的 0.8~0.9，兼顾响应与可用油量。: Usually 0.8–0.9 of the system minimum working pressure, balancing response and usable oil.
map.蓄能器容量计算工具用于皮囊式蓄能器容积选型。根据充气压力、最低与最高工作压力、所: The accumulator capacity tool sizes a bladder accumulator. From pre-charge pressure, min/max working pressure and required displaced oil, it computes total volume under isothermal (slow make-up/hold) or adiabatic (fast discharge/emergency) assumption and gives a recommended volume with safety margin.
